text: dsh-next-prompt 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的提示建议插件，在对话输入框 dock 展示下一步提示。它从最近的公开对话文本构造有限上下文，在最近一轮完成、会话空闲且草稿为空时，调用该轮使用的 provider 和 model 生成一条简短建议；新一轮开始时会取消过期请求并缓存成功结果。点击建议只把文字填入草稿，不会提交。适合希望获得后续提问灵感的 DSH Web 用户。需要 DSH Web 与已配置的 LLM provider/model；对话文本会作为生成上下文传给该 provider。

dsh-next-prompt suggests a follow-up prompt in the DSH Web input dock. After an eligible completed turn, it uses recent conversation text and that turn’s provider/model to generate a suggestion. Clicking fills the draft without submitting it. It requires DSH Web and a configured LLM provider.
想让 DSH 在一轮回答结束后给我一个可以继续追问的草稿。
有没有办法根据刚才的对话自动想出下一句提示词，但先别替我发送？
让聊天输入框在回答完成后显示一个后续问题建议，点一下只填到草稿里。
dsh-next-prompt 的功能「后续提示建议」：符合条件的回答结束后，使用近期公开对话文本和当前轮次的 provider/model 生成一条简短提示，并显示在输入框 dock。点击按钮会把建议填入草稿，用户可自行修改或提交。
dsh-next-prompt feature “Follow-up”: it suggests a prompt after a completed turn. Clicking fills the draft only.
dsh-next-prompt sends up to 4,000 characters of recent conversation text to the selected provider/model for generation.

@sitex/dsh-next-prompt README · dsh-next-prompt：Standalone next-prompt suggestions for DeepSeek Harness Web.

`@sitex/dsh-next-prompt` adds a Cordis host plugin and one additive Web client occupant in
`conversation.input.dock`. After an eligible completed assistant turn, the plugin may generate one
concise next user prompt. Selecting the suggestion fills the public composer draft through
`inputActions.setDraft`; it never submits the draft.

The package targets DeepSeek Harness `0.1.1-rc.2` and is independent of `tools-dsh`.

@sitex/dsh-next-prompt README · Requirements：- Node.js `>=22.19.0`
- pnpm `11.24.0` through Corepack
- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.1-rc.2`

All declared DSH development and peer packages are pinned exactly to `0.1.1-rc.2`.

@sitex/dsh-next-prompt README · Installation：The current working installation path is a locally packed tarball:

```bash
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm build
corepack pnpm pack --pack-destination .dsh-smoke
corepack pnpm exec dsh plugin --profile default add .dsh-smoke/sitex-dsh-next-prompt-0.1.0.tgz

The package ships `cordis.patch.yml`. DSH composes one `dsh-next-prompt` row whose package root is
the Cordis host plugin; the same package manifest supplies the official Web client metadata.

@sitex/dsh-next-prompt README · After npm publication：The registry command below becomes valid only after `@sitex/dsh-next-prompt` is published. This
repository does not publish npm as part of issue #2.

```bash
corepack pnpm exec dsh plugin --profile default add @sitex/dsh-next-prompt
```

@sitex/dsh-next-prompt README · Eligibility：A suggestion is generated only when all of these conditions hold:

- The latest turn ended with reason `completed`.
- The session is idle and has no prompt or agent error.
- The input phase is `plain`.
- The trimmed draft is empty.
- There are no draft images.
- Recent public conversation context is nonempty.
- The completed turn exposes a provider and model route.

@sitex/dsh-next-prompt README · Eligibility：Running, error, cancelled, aborted, blocked, interrupted, nonempty-draft, image-draft, session-switch,
timeout, RPC failure, invalid-response, empty-output, and superseded states hide the suggestion.

@sitex/dsh-next-prompt README · Eligibility：Each retained `sessionId:turnEndSeq` record receives at most one generation attempt. A successful
suggestion is cached for that turn and returns when the draft becomes eligible again. A failed
attempt is not retried while its record remains retained. A newer turn aborts the older request,
and stale results never publish.
The browser controller retains at most 64 recent turn records across sessions. Insertion-order
eviction preserves the current turn and any active request; revisiting an evicted turn may generate
once again, while late results from its previous record cannot delete or resurrect the replacement.

@sitex/dsh-next-prompt README · Generation boundary：- Context contains only recent public user and assistant text from the conversation snapshot.
- Context is bounded to 4,000 characters.
- Output is bounded to 80 model tokens and 120 displayed graphemes.
- Generation receives the completed turn's public provider/model route.
- `tools` is always an empty array.
- The host makes one LLM stream attempt per eligible turn.
- Output is normalized to one physical line without labels, list markers, or code fences.

@sitex/dsh-next-prompt README · Generation boundary：The plugin does not read transcript DOM, hidden model input, tool results, images, credentials, or
provider-private state. It executes no tool or capability and performs no file mutation.

@sitex/dsh-next-prompt README · Composer behavior：The client registers only `conversation.input.dock` at order `10`. It renders one semantic button
named `Fill draft with suggested prompt`. Native click, Enter, and Space activation call only
`inputActions.setDraft`.

The package deliberately does not:

@sitex/dsh-next-prompt README · Composer behavior：- Submit or auto-submit the draft.
- Replace the composer or conversation surface.
- Monkey-patch textarea, placeholder, backdrop, mirror, or transcript DOM.
- Intercept Tab or ArrowRight.
- Register sidebar, overlay, Projects, inventory, CLI, MCP, or Herdr surfaces.

DSH `0.1.1-rc.2` exposes no public ghost-text or key-acceptance seam, so input-dock fill UI is the
supported implementation boundary.

@sitex/dsh-next-prompt README · Composer behavior：The RPC is registered with DSH authority `loopback`. This package follows the DSH plugin trust
model: locally installed Cordis plugins and the local Web client are trusted profile members. It is
not a network API and is not intended to provide an authorization boundary between mutually
untrusted local plugins.

@sitex/dsh-next-prompt README · Architecture：- `src/contracts.ts`: bounded Zod request/response schemas and protocol constants.
- `src/context.ts`: public conversation text projection.
- `src/controller.ts`: one-attempt ledger, caching, timeout, and stale cancellation.
- `src/rpc.ts`: no-tools host LLM stream handler.
- `src/plugin.ts`: loopback Cordis RPC registration.
- `src/client/NextSuggestionDock.tsx`: public composer state projection and draft-fill UI.
- `src/client/index.tsx`: browser RPC bridge, single slot registration, and style ownership.
- `src/client/styles.ts`: DSH-token-only dock styling.
@sitex/dsh-next-prompt README · Architecture：See [DESIGN.md](./DESIGN.md) for the visual and accessibility contract.

@sitex/dsh-next-prompt README · Development：```bash
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm lint
corepack pnpm typecheck
corepack pnpm test

`smoke:profile` builds and packs the repository, installs only the tarball into isolated DSH
profiles, verifies the Cordis patch and exports from an unrelated working directory, starts an
isolated real DSH Web server, and inspects the served browser module.
